Dream 2026-11-22 linked 4 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-11-06 · touches · "what may still be missing is the way to compare parents, siblings and children." (A way of working is emerging: shared semantic infrastructure under domains and essays, comparing parents, siblings and children, cloning a domain, and zoomability (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "it is also probably still fine to call a cluster a cluster... Because it is a boundary that performs a function." (Simple domains lack clarity to be useful; cells are relative to a boundary, divide and repeat; dream boundaries are valid if we know where they came from; cluster may stay a name for a boundary with a function (2026-11-07))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "A cluster is probably just another boundary." (A cluster is just another boundary; sensed boundaries are clarified after, declared boundaries are held before looking inside (2026-11-07))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "I need to see them together to allow comparing." (The calibration practice: rows with filters, a confidence per coordinate, items seen together to compare, relative order within a selection, going up and down; naming a cell once enough is mapped and testing against the name; cross-checking with the zodiac (3x4) and tarot (3x7, no fool) layers, the 4 and 7 mapping the same row with different valence (2026-11-07))
